## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm check`
- [ ] `pnpm release:check`
- [ ] Relevant smoke/deployment validation completed when applicable
- [ ] Documentation or changelog updated for user-visible changes

## Trading and security safety

- [ ] No API keys, secrets, passwords, confirmation tokens, account details, or private deployment URLs are included
- [ ] Live/Demo separation and explicit user-confirmation behavior remain safe
- [ ] Ambiguous write outcomes are not automatically retried
- [ ] OAuth, deployment, credential-storage, order-limit, and permission impacts were considered
